# NoClaudKit

> Small free tools for everyday files that run in the browser. Files never leave your device: processing happens locally, nothing is uploaded, no account needed.

Available now: an image converter. Image compression and resizing tools are planned but not available yet.

## Tools

- [Local Image Converter](https://noclaudkit.com/image-converter/llms.txt): HEIC/HEIF, WebP, AVIF, PNG and JPEG to JPEG, PNG, or WebP/AVIF where the browser can encode them; runs locally in the browser
- [Image converter overview (Markdown)](https://noclaudkit.com/image-converter/index.md)
